summary: The agent implements a highly robust and defensively-coded solution, successfully addressing data cleaning, feature engineering, and categorical handling without any data leakage. However, it exhibits a few methodological shortcomings: evaluating stochastic models on a single validation split (FM14), relying solely on accuracy for evaluation (FM15), and using naive unweighted ensembling (FM12).
